sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A shrub or small tree native to the Mascarenes and neighboring Indian Ocean regions. It commonly reaches 4–6 m and bears narrow leaves in whorls, especially toward branch tips.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Small fragrant flowers are followed by orange to red berries. This species is more compact than Socotra’s dragon tree (D. cinnabari), which has a broad umbrella-shaped crown.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The sources consulted do not report established food use.
